verdict.rationale: Render documents its own REST API and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Its official CLI manages services, Postgres and Key Value instances, and its MCP server manages infrastructure from AI apps, so a broad programmatic surface clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that the API matches the dashboard feature for feature. Missing for 10: an explicit claim or documentation of API/UI parity, endpoint coverage detail for areas like domains, env vars, previews, scaling and billing, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Render CLI can manage services, Render Postgres databases, and Render Key Value instances.
Render's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables you to manage your Render infrastructure directly from compatible AI apps
